leftEvidence.title: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: After six days Jesus takes three disciples up a high mountain; his face shines, his clothes become white, and Moses and Elijah appear speaking with him.
points.right: About eight days after the sayings Jesus takes Peter, John, and James up the mountain to pray; his face changes and his clothing flashes white.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Peter proposes three tents; a bright cloud overshadows them, the voice names the beloved Son and commands listening, and the frightened disciples finally see Jesus alone.
points.right: Moses and Elijah speak of his departure to be completed at Jerusalem; sleepy disciples see glory, Peter proposes tents, a cloud brings fear, and the voice names the chosen Son.

payload.posture: Both preserve three disciples, changed appearance, Moses and Elijah, glory, tents, cloud, voice, and silence.

rightEvidence.title: Luke places prayer and an exodus conversation on the mountain

payload.tension: Matthew says after six days; Luke says about eight, adds prayer, sleep, and the departure to be completed at Jerusalem.
payload.title: Matthew and Luke on the mountain
